absent: Complete grace period phase progression beyond the force quiescent wait state and associated transitions.
Segmented callback list layout plus rules for advancing accelerating and invoking callbacks.
Stall timeout duration calculation suppression policy and restart conditions.
Offloaded callback wakeup protocol timer behavior and locking beyond early initialization.
Reader side tracking deferred quiescence and special unlock handling details.
Barrier sequence management entrainment across CPUs and completion wakeup path.
Boost thread main execution loop and priority adjustment effects.
Expedited grace period initiation completion and poll state representation.

findings.text: Provides a completed polling state for both normal and expedited grace periods, usable as an already satisfied snapshot without waiting.
Captures the current full grace period state into caller storage and arms the shared polling machinery so later polls observe progress.
Blocks for a full grace period unless a poll of the supplied snapshot already shows completion.
Establishes the sequencing and quiescent bookkeeping needed for a CPU becoming online, with successful completion indicated numerically.
Starvation is declared when elapsed time since last recorded activity exceeds twice the per-second tick rate; optional output receives the elapsed duration.
Each barrier callback marks its own record as invoked; the shared remaining count reaching zero signals completion exactly once per generation.
Barrier requests are spaced in time to avoid overload; a recent prior request causes a short idle sleep with early exit if the awaited generation completes meanwhile.
Per-CPU work flags start cleared; when softirq-driven handling is selected no per-CPU kernel threads are created.

Self stall reporting acquires the leaf node lock around per-CPU diagnostic emission and separately acquires the root node lock when re-arming the stall deadline, with interrupts disabled throughout the caller context.
Barrier entrainment on the local CPU executes with interrupts disabled and under the global barrier lock.
Boost thread publication is protected by the node lock with interrupt state preserved, while parallel expedited worker creation and boost creation share the node thread mutex.

Per-CPU thread control comprises a status word, a work flag byte, and an activity timestamp; the hotplug descriptor binds storage for the task pointer with run, predicate, naming, setup and park hooks.
Stall time accounting snapshot holds interrupt, soft-interrupt and system time plus counters for interrupts, soft-interrupts, context switches and a timestamp, keyed by grace sequence.
Barrier trigger parameter pairs get and set operations with a shared atomic counter reflecting concurrent trigger users.
Per-CPU kernel thread cycles among waiting, running and yielding, with parking moving it to off-CPU; execution repeats bounded attempts to drain work before yielding briefly.
Force-quiescent wait has a distinct grace state; expiry is recognized when current time passes the recorded deadline by at least a stall-suspicion interval while the grace thread remains queued out.

Core per-CPU processing handles deferred quiescent reports, callback advancement and invocation, stall start checks and offload wakeups; the soft-interrupt variant delegates to the same logic and strict mode queues a clean-environment reader.

Scheduler clock handling differs by configuration: one variant manages deferred versus immediate quiescent reports with rescheduling and aging assistance, the other reports quiescence on user, idle or non-nested interrupt entry.
Strict grace work executes a minimal read-side critical section to provide a quiescent point in a clean workqueue context.

Early boot establishes per-CPU identity, sequencing baselines and deferred work linkage; callback-offload preparation either initializes queues, locks and timers or does nothing depending on configuration.
Verbose stall diagnostics execute while holding node locks and explicitly avoid tripping the hard lockup detector during extended console output.
Detected stalls combine emergency console handling, stack collection, optional panic, and rescheduling; prolonged grace thread deprivation makes memory exhaustion the anticipated outcome.
Grace thread starvation threshold equals twice the number of ticks per second.
Barrier throttle spacing equals one sixteenth of the per-second tick rate.
Laziness of callback handling defaults from build configuration with an override forcing it disabled in one configuration.
Leak callback provides a no-operation callback target that performs no action when invoked.
CPU online preparation serializes initial field setup under the root node lock with interrupts disabled and completes leaf association under the leaf lock.
Barrier trigger via parameter write is rejected before scheduler readiness, and otherwise increments the user count around a throttled barrier.

Expedited handling uses one global worker plus at most one parallel worker per node, each preferring CPUs under its node and using elevated scheduling when configured; repeated creation requests leave existing workers unchanged.
Readers affected by priority inversion are served by an optional per-node boost thread; one build creates and wakes such a thread once, the other build provides no operation.
